text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two ways to find the same deformation field

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Both take a fixed and a moving image that are already linearly aligned, and both return a dense displacement field.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What differs is what they solve for, and how.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ANTs SyN

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: continuous optimisation, by gradient descent

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gridpoint

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: discrete optimisation, by exhaustive search

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every voxel is an unknown

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only grid nodes are unknowns

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One displacement vector per voxel. At CCF 10 um that is

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 1.2 billion unknowns, and the field is updated

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: everywhere on every one of hundreds of iterations.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One vector per control node, 30 voxels apart at the

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: coarsest level. About 50,000 unknowns for the same

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: brain; every voxel in between is interpolated from them.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Follow the gradient, in small steps

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Score every candidate, keep the best

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cost

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it stops here

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the better match

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure the metric gradient, take a step, smooth,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: repeat. The step size and the iteration count are yours

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to tune, and a match that lies past the nearest dip is

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not reachable from here.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: best

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for ONE node,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 29,791 offsets,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: all scored

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every offset in a cube around the node is scored with

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: normalised cross-correlation, and the cheapest is taken

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outright. No step size, no local minimum: a 15-voxel

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: jump costs no more to find than a 1-voxel one.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blur the field

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spanning tree, then two sweeps

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: raw update

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gaussian blur, sigma voxels

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Smoothness is imposed afterwards, by blurring. The width

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of that blur is the regulariser, and it is the same

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: everywhere in the image.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: root

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one sweep leaves to root, one sweep back

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Smoothness is part of the cost, not applied afterwards:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: neighbouring nodes pay for disagreeing. Reduced to a

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spanning tree, that cost can be minimised exactly in one

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sweep to the root and one back.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What they share

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A coarse-to-fine pyramid. And both register fixed to moving

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AND moving to fixed, then compose the two halves, which is

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: what makes the result invertible rather than merely smooth.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where it bites

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ANTs is continuous, so it is sub-voxel everywhere but has to

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: walk to a distant match. gridpoint jumps straight to it, but

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: only inside the candidate cube, and quantises to the label

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: grid.
